correctness.rationale: PASS: Every fixed point lies in [-2A,2A]. The first three derivatives of the residual h(t)=sin(w1 t)+sin(w2 t)-(t+phi)/A cannot vanish together: first and third force both cosines zero when frequencies are distinct, while second would force w1=w2. Compactness and Rolle give an all-phase uniform bound <=3 distinct roots per short interval. Pick a short mesh with torus-uniquely-ergodic translation; Fourier geometric sums and slow-variable Riemann sums give uniform phase-independent strict-sign crossings. Multi-root/tangency cells must lie near both S=s and D=0, whose normalized density O(h m(|D|<=O(h))) vanishes; the same strip controls nonrepelling fixed points. Dominated convergence gives C and Jensen/strict triangle bounds. Independent torus quadrature for (1,sqrt(2)) gave C~1.01692789697; finitely many root counts are not infinite proof.
